PORT.description: Service port. Keep 8080 to match the public domain target.

VARVE_API_TOKEN.description: Generated operator token for HTTPS and WebSocket clients. Grants database-wide access; keep private.

VARVE_DATA_DIR.description: Database directory on the persistent volume. Keep /data/varve.

VARVE_REQUIRE_VOLUME.description: Keep 1 to refuse startup without a mounted /data volume.

VARVE_HTTP_REQUEST_QUEUE.description: Bounded shared application request admission capacity.

VARVE_WS_ORIGINS.description: Optional comma-separated exact browser origins, such as https://app.example.com. Empty rejects browser origins; no wildcard.

VARVE_USE_S3.description: Keep true to publish asynchronous recovery state to the dedicated bucket.

VARVE_S3_BUCKET.description: Dedicated bucket name from the objects resource. Preserve this reference.

VARVE_S3_ENDPOINT.description: S3-compatible endpoint supplied by the objects resource.

VARVE_S3_REGION.description: Signing region for Railway object storage; keep auto.

VARVE_S3_PREFIX.description: Single-writer recovery namespace within the dedicated bucket. Do not share with another active database.

AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID.description: Bucket-generated access key reference; do not copy validation credentials.

AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.description: Bucket-generated secret key reference; preserve the reference and keep private.
